title: feat: add the ip slot and feed hub to the legacy image cache (unused)
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Configured the legacy image-cache Worker with custom domains in order: image.myceli.ai, then image.pollinations.ai. Disabled its workers.dev and preview URLs. Added unused IP_SLOT and FEED_HUB SQLite Durable Object bindings to production and test configuration, with shared class exports and a v1 migration. Updated Wrangler to ^4.147.0 and @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers to ^0.12.21 while retaining the 2025-08-01 compatibility date. All seven tests pass, including a binding test; wrangler dev boots and a production dry run lists both objects. As the Worker's first Durable Object migration, v1 becomes its rollback baseline; earlier versions cannot be rollback targets after deployment. The new bindings do not change image requests yet.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden server shed, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and checks two labeled route signs beside a quiet retro image-cache terminal, while two unopened seed pots marked IP_SLOT and FEED_HUB sit nearby; the cute pixel art bee mascot has a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, and she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized or realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and lavender tones, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
